title: Convert consequential outcomes into bounded future-learning candidates

intent.outcome: Supported source-owned outcome evidence compiles into bounded advisory future-context candidates that reconciliation cannot silently lose, while one-off and already-absorbed evidence stays artifact-free.
non_goals: Do not add a learning event store, transcript/log retention, generic retrospective, or Memory-specific capture ritual.
Do not implement later effectiveness classification or stronger-owner promotion in this slice.
Do not encode GitHub, test runner, linter, or chat provider names in portable core.

parent.contribution: Supply the heterogeneous producer and custody front half used by every later learning slice.
parent.closure_boundary: Issue #2810 only; #2811-#2813 and parent #2809 remain open.

effects: Generic outcome evidence already visible to AW is assessed and projected through existing reconciliation custody.
Candidate authority never exceeds its source and semantic agent generalization remains advisory.
No-evidence and explicit no-learning paths remain absent from first-line output and durable state.

delegation.reason: The stacked slices are sequential and share the same contract surface; current runtime policy does not permit agent delegation.

next_action: Implement the generic outcome-evidence compiler, compose it into operating decisions, and prove heterogeneous sources plus no-learning controls.

claims: Convert consequential outcomes into bounded future-learning candidates is implemented, validated, and closed out honestly.
requirements: uv run --frozen --active --no-sync pytest tests/test_future_learning.py tests/test_reconciliation.py tests/test_operating_decision.py -q
